title: Our Approach
description: How SilkCover Consulting runs an assignment: four stages from first question to final result.

menu.label: Our Approach
menu.blurb: How an assignment moves from question to result.

hero.title: From the first question to a result you can use
hero.lede: Every assignment moves through the same four stages, from defining the question to delivering agreed outputs and handling data securely.

stages.title: Listen
stages.text: Understand the decision you face, the context around it and the people it affects.
happens: Define the question, the intended users and the decisions the study should inform
Inception plan: methods, sampling, ethics, staffing, schedule and analysis
stages.receive: An inception plan setting out the agreed questions, methods and timeline.
stages.you: A briefing on the decision you face, and access to the documents and people who know the context.

stages.title: Evidence
stages.text: Gather and test the facts with methods suited to the setting and the question.
happens: Develop, translate and pilot research tools
Train field teams in interviewing, consent, safeguarding, data protection and quality control
Collect data with supervision, validation and proportionate checks
stages.receive: Tested tools, supervised fieldwork and a briefing on emerging findings.
stages.you: Introductions and permissions that open the right doors.

stages.title: Design
stages.text: Turn findings into practical options with clear trade-offs and costs.
happens: Clean and analyse the evidence, documenting missing data and important decisions
Technical review of findings, limitations and practical recommendations
stages.receive: Draft findings with limitations clearly stated and practical recommendations.
stages.you: Review and feedback, so the final version fits how you work.

stages.title: Deliver
stages.text: Implement, report and learn, so the next decision starts from a stronger base.
happens: Handle data securely at the end of the assignment
stages.receive: Depending on the project: technical report, policy brief, strategic assessment, presentation, recommendations matrix, methodology note and de-identified data.
stages.you: Decisions on next steps, with implementation support if you want it.

section.title: Principles that hold across every stage

items.title: Independent analysis
items.text: Working relationships support coordination but never influence findings or imply official endorsement.

items.title: Ethical and safe
items.text: Participation is voluntary and informed. The safety and privacy of participants guide the choice of method.

items.title: Pashto, Dari and English
items.text: Questionnaires and materials are translated and tested in the relevant languages before fieldwork.

items.title: Recognised guidance
items.text: We follow recognised professional guidance such as the ICC/ESOMAR research code, AAPOR survey guidance and OECD evaluation criteria. This does not imply certification or endorsement by those organisations.

closing.title: Begin with a conversation
closing.text: Stage one starts with listening. Tell us about the question you are facing.
